text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Recently, a new game called "Uma Riddles" has become all the rage among the students at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It involves solving a series of riddles left around the school, and Sakura Bakushin O decided to take on the challenge after a classmate recommended she try.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Aaagh! I haven't the faintest idea!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Being a model student, I should be leading the charge on solving this mystery! But I'm getting nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Although I'd be extremely grateful, it wouldn't set a good example, would it?
choice_data_list: You could inspire others through your willingness to cooperate with your trainer.
You could inspire others through your willingness to cooperate with your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, there's no problem then! Time to put my class representative prowess to the test!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh! It seems I can "receive a hint from Nakayama"?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Nakayama… Nakayama… Nakayama must be…
choice_data_list: Perhaps something to do with Nakayama Racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! There's a popular girl called Nakayama here at the academy.
choice_data_list: Why don't you ask her for the hint directly?
Why don't you ask her for the hint directly?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Our first hurdle on the path to our goal! With my guts and fighting spirit, I'll track her down!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I found you, Nakayama! Okay! Let me have the third Uma Riddle hint!
choice_data_list: She won't understand what you're talking about if that's all you say…

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: No, I understand. You mean the "receive a hint from Nakayama," message right? I am actually the Nakayama the message talks about.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …But I'm not giving it to you that easily.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Why?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You'll have to battle me for the hint. If you win, I'll tell you what you want to know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Let me see… In your case, how about being banned from your class representative duties for a day?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You don't need to worry! My class representative prowess will definitely help me seize victory!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Nice. Those are the eyes of someone willing to bet it all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'll let you decide the details. Let's make it a battle to remember!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Wait… sorry. Could you say what you just said again?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Sure! My class representative prowess will definitely help me seize victory!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Class… representative prowess?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Indeed! I always conduct myself with the mindset and behavior befitting a class representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Nakayama! Let's have a competition to decide who has what it takes to be called class representative!
choice_data_list: You can refuse, Nakayama, it's okay.
You can refuse, Nakayama, it's okay.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: No, I would never back down from someone with the determination to put everything on the line.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Besides, the more overwhelmingly unfavorable the odds, the more fired up I get!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so begins the competition for the title of ultimate class representative.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two battle it out to see which one of them can talk and behave the most like a class representative in a variety of situations…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O dominates the early rounds, but Nakayama Festa shows great tenacity, resulting in a fierce battle that stays tense till the very end.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Victory is mine!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh, it's my loss… Your strength as a class representative runs deep.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: As I promised, the hint is yours. Keep up the good work, Class Representative!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the Nakayama Festa's hint, Bakushin O was finally able to solve all the Uma Riddles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Safe from being banned from her class representative duties, she remains in a cheerful mood.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! Being a Tracen student is all about racing! And when it comes to racing, the racecourse is the place to be!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, an excellent deduction!
choice_data_list: It's outside the school grounds though…
It's outside the school grounds though…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: On the contrary! If you see the racecourse as another place of learning, it could be considered a part of the school!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm heading over to the Nakayama Racecourse this weekend! The hint must be over there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although I'm not so sure about her reasoning, it wouldn't be a bad idea to check out the Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In addition to solving the riddle, it could be a good chance to learn about the racecourse itself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, that weekend…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh! Here it is! Nakayama Racecourse!
choice_data_list: Since we're here, why don't we take a look around?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay! We'll do that while looking into the Uma Riddle!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Look! Check out the final stretch before the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That hill is the final obstacle. If I Bakushin up it and reach the finish line in first place…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I bet it would feel amazing!
choice_data_list: That's why you need to work on maintaining your energy levels.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But of course! I'll work even harder!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'll ensure that the name Sakura Bakushin O decks the hallowed halls of Nakayama Racecourse for generations to come!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But I won't be able to succeed like this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I have to head back to the academy and get training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Blasting toward a glorious future! Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems my words fall on deaf ears as I watch Sakura Bakushin O disappear from view.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: BAKU-SHIN! BA-KU-SHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let's finish here today.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Oh! Class Representative! Nice work today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Thanks! You guys too!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Didn't you say you were off to Nakayama Racecourse? Did you give up?

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text: Well, Nakayama Racecourse isn't the Nakayama from the Uma Riddle anyway, so…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Uma Riddle… "Nakayama"?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: OHHH! It totally slipped my mind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, there wasn't enough time for Sakura Bakushin O to completely solve the Uma Riddles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the information she gained at Nakayama Racecourse helped her grow a little.
